units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|You step down onto the landing pad and your breath makes a white halo. The spaceport is unusually foggy, and the chilling wind causes a reflexive shiver to run up the base of your neck.|930|0
units.english: You step down onto the landing pad and your breath makes a white halo. The spaceport is unusually foggy, and the chilling wind causes a reflexive shiver to run up the base of your neck.
units.italian: Scendi sulla piattaforma di atterraggio e il tuo fiato forma un alone bianco. Lo spazioporto è insolitamente nebbioso, e il vento gelido ti fa correre un brivido alla base della nuca.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	A grizzled man emerges from the fog with an easy, unhurried gait, a laser rifle slung over one shoulder. A hulking beast lumbers at his side: a horse-sized hound cloaked in heavy, wooly fur rimmed with frost. Two enormous tusks thrust from its muzzle like pale sabers. Steam billows from its flared nostrils as it turns its head almost lazily toward you. Its eyes carry a grim patience.|931|0
units.english: A grizzled man emerges from the fog with an easy, unhurried gait, a laser rifle slung over one shoulder. A hulking beast lumbers at his side: a horse-sized hound cloaked in heavy, wooly fur rimmed with frost. Two enormous tusks thrust from its muzzle like pale sabers. Steam billows from its flared nostrils as it turns its head almost lazily toward you. Its eyes carry a grim patience.
units.italian: Dalla nebbia emerge un uomo incartapecorito, con un'andatura tranquilla e senza fretta, un fucile laser a tracolla. Al suo fianco avanza pesante una bestia enorme: un segugio grande come un cavallo, avvolto in una folta pelliccia lanosa orlata di brina. Due zanne enormi gli sporgono dal muso come sciabole pallide. Il vapore esce a ondate dalle narici dilatate mentre gira la testa quasi con pigrizia verso di te. I suoi occhi hanno una pazienza cupa.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	The man sees you and grunts, "Don't stare at a Mammoth Mastiff."|932|0
units.english: The man sees you and grunts, "Don't stare at a Mammoth Mastiff."
units.italian: L'uomo ti vede e grugnisce: "Non fissare un Mastino Mammut."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	"What's a Mammoth Mastiff?"|934|0
units.english: "What's a Mammoth Mastiff?"
units.italian: "Cos'è un Mastino Mammut?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	"Don't tell me what to do!"|935|0
units.english: "Don't tell me what to do!"
units.italian: "Non dirmi cosa devo fare!"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	(Avert my gaze and get back to my ship.)|937|0
units.english: (Avert my gaze and get back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Distogli lo sguardo e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	"A phantom from harsher times, bred on Hestia when it was still lifeless ice. Now nothing more than a tool of the trade." He pats the creature and it lets out a low rumble.|939|0
units.english: "A phantom from harsher times, bred on Hestia when it was still lifeless ice. Now nothing more than a tool of the trade." He pats the creature and it lets out a low rumble.
units.italian: "Un fantasma di tempi più duri, allevato su Hestia quando era ancora ghiaccio senza vita. Ora non è più che uno strumento del mestiere." Dà una pacca alla creatura, che emette un ringhio basso.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	The man bellows a deep laugh as the fog thickens. The creature's eyes are the last things to pierce the haze before man and mastiff alike fade away. You find yourself alone once more.|941|0
units.english: The man bellows a deep laugh as the fog thickens. The creature's eyes are the last things to pierce the haze before man and mastiff alike fade away. You find yourself alone once more.
units.italian: L'uomo scoppia in una risata profonda mentre la nebbia si infittisce. Gli occhi della creatura sono l'ultima cosa che trapassa la foschia prima che uomo e mastino svaniscano. Ti ritrovi di nuovo solo.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|You steady yourself on the floating city-ship as the necklace of barges, docks, and gantries creak and sway under the influence of Mainsail's endless ocean waves. Salt spray stings your face as you head out towards the ring. One barge rocks close, its deck slick with algae, while a local fearlessly walks a four-legged whale-like creature on a leash - a seal-sized mass of compact muscle under slate fur, with webbed paws that click on the planks, a long whiskered snout bristling with needlelike teeth and a broad, flattened tail that wags with anticipation.|951|0
units.english: You steady yourself on the floating city-ship as the necklace of barges, docks, and gantries creak and sway under the influence of Mainsail's endless ocean waves. Salt spray stings your face as you head out towards the ring. One barge rocks close, its deck slick with algae, while a local fearlessly walks a four-legged whale-like creature on a leash - a seal-sized mass of compact muscle under slate fur, with webbed paws that click on the planks, a long whiskered snout bristling with needlelike teeth and a broad, flattened tail that wags with anticipation.
units.italian: Ti reggi sulla città-nave galleggiante mentre la collana di chiatte, moli e gru scricchiola e ondeggia sotto l'influsso delle onde senza fine di Mainsail. Lo spruzzo salmastro ti punge il viso mentre ti dirigi verso l'anello. Una chiatta si avvicina ondeggiando, la coperta viscida di alghe, mentre un locale passeggia senza paura al guinzaglio una creatura quadrupede simile a una balena: una massa compatta di muscoli grande come una foca sotto un pelo ardesia, con zampe palmate che ticchettano sulle assi, un lungo muso baffuto irto di denti aghiformi e una larga coda appiattita che scodinzola di aspettativa.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	The local catches you gawking, flashes a salt-creased grin and calls, "Never seen a seadog before?|952|0
units.english: The local catches you gawking, flashes a salt-creased grin and calls, "Never seen a seadog before?
units.italian: Il locale ti coglie a fissare, abbozza un sorriso segnato dal sale e chiama: "Non hai mai visto un cane di mare?

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"Can't say I have!"|954|0
units.english: "Can't say I have!"
units.italian: "Non posso dire di sì!"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"What is that thing?"|955|0
units.english: "What is that thing?"
units.italian: "Cos'è quella cosa?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"Of course I've seen a seadog before!"|956|0
units.english: "Of course I've seen a seadog before!"
units.italian: "Certo che ho già visto un cane di mare!"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	(Avert my gaze and get back to my ship.)|958|0
units.english: (Avert my gaze and get back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Distogli lo sguardo e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"Ah, that, my friend, is a Mainsail Seadog, the premier water-sporting hound of the Paradise Planets. Bred some four centuries ago in the ateliers of this very planet, they marry old water-dog stock with dolphin and otter blood, with a touch of beaver for the tail, crocodile for the jaws, and barracuda for the strike," he says with a wink. "They'll nose out a school, haul in the finest fish, and lay a damp, grateful head upon your boots - a prized rarity since the Republic put a lid on the gene labs."|962|0
units.english: "Ah, that, my friend, is a Mainsail Seadog, the premier water-sporting hound of the Paradise Planets. Bred some four centuries ago in the ateliers of this very planet, they marry old water-dog stock with dolphin and otter blood, with a touch of beaver for the tail, crocodile for the jaws, and barracuda for the strike," he says with a wink. "They'll nose out a school, haul in the finest fish, and lay a damp, grateful head upon your boots - a prized rarity since the Republic put a lid on the gene labs."
units.italian: "Ah, quello, amico mio, è un Cane di Mare di Mainsail, il miglior segugio acquatico dei Mondi del Paradiso. Allevati circa quattro secoli fa negli atelier di questo stesso pianeta, uniscono vecchi ceppi di cani d'acqua con sangue di delfino e di lontra, con un tocco di castoro per la coda, di coccodrillo per le mascelle e di barracuda per lo scatto", dice con un occhiolino. "Fiutano un banco, tirano su il pesce migliore e ti posano una testa umida e riconoscente sugli stivali: una rarità pregiata, da quando la Repubblica ha chiuso i laboratori genetici."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"Glad to hear that, my friend! Too few have seen the prized rarity of a Mainsail Seadog nowadays, since the Republic put a lid on the labs."|965|0
units.english: "Glad to hear that, my friend! Too few have seen the prized rarity of a Mainsail Seadog nowadays, since the Republic put a lid on the labs."
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo, amico mio! Oggi troppo pochi hanno visto la rarità pregiata di un Cane di Mare di Mainsail, da quando la Repubblica ha chiuso i laboratori."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	With a practiced motion he hops from the barge into a sleek, unpowered skiff. The seadog slips from the barge like a ribbon, dives cleanly into the sea, and sets its broad tail to the waves. In a spray of salt the steely creature hauls them off, and the boat recedes like a chariot of Poseidon into the harbor haze.|967|0
units.english: With a practiced motion he hops from the barge into a sleek, unpowered skiff. The seadog slips from the barge like a ribbon, dives cleanly into the sea, and sets its broad tail to the waves. In a spray of salt the steely creature hauls them off, and the boat recedes like a chariot of Poseidon into the harbor haze.
units.italian: Con un movimento esperto salta dalla chiatta su uno skiff snello e senza motore. Il cane di mare scivola dalla chiatta come un nastro, si tuffa pulito in mare e mette la larga coda alle onde. In uno spruzzo di sale la creatura d'acciaio li trascina via, e la barca si allontana come un carro di Poseidone nella foschia del porto.

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|As your ship settles down on landing pad A5B, two young adults approach. One speaks up, "Hello, Captain. Have you seen a woman named Anna Fangvin anywhere? She was last seen in the spaceport, and must have left in someone's spaceship."|979|0
units.english: As your ship settles down on landing pad A5B, two young adults approach. One speaks up, "Hello, Captain. Have you seen a woman named Anna Fangvin anywhere? She was last seen in the spaceport, and must have left in someone's spaceship."
units.italian: Mentre la tua nave si posa sulla piattaforma A5B, si avvicinano due giovani. Uno prende la parola: "Salve, capitano. Ha visto da qualche parte una donna di nome Anna Fangvin? È stata vista l'ultima volta nello spazioporto, e dev'essere partita sulla nave di qualcuno."

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	Around the spaceport you see a few other groups doing the same thing. Anna may have been more popular than she thought.|980|0
units.english: Around the spaceport you see a few other groups doing the same thing. Anna may have been more popular than she thought.
units.italian: Intorno allo spazioporto vedi altri gruppi che fanno la stessa cosa. Anna forse era più popolare di quanto pensasse.

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	"She went to another star system a long ways from here. You won't be able to get to her."|982|0
units.english: "She went to another star system a long ways from here. You won't be able to get to her."
units.italian: "È andata in un altro sistema stellare, molto lontano da qui. Non potrete raggiungerla."

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	"No, I don't know. Sorry."|983|0
units.english: "No, I don't know. Sorry."
units.italian: "No, non lo so. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	"If you ever see her again, tell her that the Coalition of Book Enjoyers appreciates her work. It wouldn't be possible for you to bring us to her location?" You respond in the negative, and the two go off to the other groups to spread the news.|985|0
units.english: "If you ever see her again, tell her that the Coalition of Book Enjoyers appreciates her work. It wouldn't be possible for you to bring us to her location?" You respond in the negative, and the two go off to the other groups to spread the news.
units.italian: "Se mai la rivedrà, le dica che la Coalizione degli Amanti dei Libri apprezza il suo lavoro. Non sarebbe possibile per lei portarci da lei?" Rispondi di no, e i due si dirigono verso gli altri gruppi a spargere la notizia.

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	Posters hang on many of the spaceport's walls - here too, Anna's books must have been famous. The posters read:|987|0
units.english: Posters hang on many of the spaceport's walls - here too, Anna's books must have been famous. The posters read:
units.italian: Sui muri di molti spazioporti ci sono manifesti; anche qui, dunque i libri di Anna dovevano essere famosi. I manifesti dicono:

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|	MISSING:|988|0
units.english: MISSING:
units.italian: SPARITA:

units.id: mission:Struggling Author Gone Missing|		Anna Fangvin, a young author whose books have been shared throughout the planet. Please report any news to the Coalition of Book Enjoyers, address 5662 Myrtle Lane, Sizertown, Zug.|989|0
units.english: Anna Fangvin, a young author whose books have been shared throughout the planet. Please report any news to the Coalition of Book Enjoyers, address 5662 Myrtle Lane, Sizertown, Zug.
units.italian: Anna Fangvin, giovane autrice i cui libri sono stati condivisi su tutto il pianeta. Si prega di segnalare qualsiasi notizia alla Coalizione degli Amanti dei Libri, indirizzo 5662 Myrtle Lane, Sizertown, Zug.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|You slowly thread your way through the dirty makeshift spaceport. It is packed with vendors and pirates haggling over illegal goods. In the distance, the sun is setting over the blood-red ocean that gives Bloodsea its name.|1003|0
units.english: You slowly thread your way through the dirty makeshift spaceport. It is packed with vendors and pirates haggling over illegal goods. In the distance, the sun is setting over the blood-red ocean that gives Bloodsea its name.
units.italian: Ti fai lentamente strada nel sudicio spazioporto improvvisato. È pieno di venditori e pirati che contrattano merci illegali. In lontananza il sole tramonta sull'oceano rosso sangue che dà il nome a Bloodsea.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	In the shadow behind a run-down shack, over which a sign advertises "the cheapest nerve gas this side o' Sol," you see a man coughing. He hacks and splutters for a while, and when he finally recovers, you notice his lips are stained with blood. As you turn away, you catch the eye of a wizened old man in the next stall.|1004|0
units.english: In the shadow behind a run-down shack, over which a sign advertises "the cheapest nerve gas this side o' Sol," you see a man coughing. He hacks and splutters for a while, and when he finally recovers, you notice his lips are stained with blood. As you turn away, you catch the eye of a wizened old man in the next stall.
units.italian: Nell'ombra dietro una baracca malridotta, sopra la quale un'insegna pubblicizza "il gas nervino più economico da questa parte del Sol", vedi un uomo che tossisce. Raschia e rantola per un po', e quando finalmente si riprende noti che ha le labbra macchiate di sangue. Mentre ti volti, incroci lo sguardo di un vecchio incartapecorito al banco accanto.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|You slowly thread your way through the dirty spaceport. It is packed with vendors and shady persons haggling over goods of dubious origin. In the distance, the sun is setting over the blood-red ocean that gives Bloodsea its name.|1007|0
units.english: You slowly thread your way through the dirty spaceport. It is packed with vendors and shady persons haggling over goods of dubious origin. In the distance, the sun is setting over the blood-red ocean that gives Bloodsea its name.
units.italian: Ti fai lentamente strada nel sudicio spazioporto. È pieno di venditori e personaggi loschi che contrattano merci di dubbia provenienza. In lontananza il sole tramonta sull'oceano rosso sangue che dà il nome a Bloodsea.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	In the shadow behind a run-down shack, over which a sign advertises "the cheapest 'nades this side o' Sol," you see a man coughing. He hacks and splutters for a while, and when he finally recovers, you notice his lips are stained with blood. As you turn away, you catch the eye of a wizened old man in the next stall.|1008|0
units.english: In the shadow behind a run-down shack, over which a sign advertises "the cheapest 'nades this side o' Sol," you see a man coughing. He hacks and splutters for a while, and when he finally recovers, you notice his lips are stained with blood. As you turn away, you catch the eye of a wizened old man in the next stall.
units.italian: Nell'ombra dietro una baracca malridotta, sopra la quale un'insegna pubblicizza "le granate più economiche da questa parte del Sol", vedi un uomo che tossisce. Raschia e rantola per un po', e quando finalmente si riprende noti che ha le labbra macchiate di sangue. Mentre ti volti, incroci lo sguardo di un vecchio incartapecorito al banco accanto.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	"He's got the Bloom," the old man pronounces solemnly. "He'll be dead in a few weeks. It's the blood tide that does it, the fools."|1010|0
units.english: "He's got the Bloom," the old man pronounces solemnly. "He'll be dead in a few weeks. It's the blood tide that does it, the fools."
units.italian: "Ha la Fioritura", sentenzia il vecchio gravemente. "Sarà morto in poche settimane. È la marea di sangue che lo fa, gli sciocchi."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	"What is it?"|1012|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	"Is it contagious?"|1013|0
units.english: "Is it contagious?"
units.italian: "È contagioso?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	(Walk away.)|1015|0
units.english: (Walk away.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	He laughs scornfully. "The sea sprays poison. No one goes there except spacers and fools. Bloody sea and bloody fools.|1017|0
units.english: He laughs scornfully. "The sea sprays poison. No one goes there except spacers and fools. Bloody sea and bloody fools.
units.italian: Ride con disprezzo. "Il mare spruzza veleno. Nessuno ci va, tranne spaziali e sciocchi. Mare di sangue e sciocchi di sangue.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	"Yes," he says simply. You automatically recoil from the coughing man.|1020|0
units.english: "Yes," he says simply. You automatically recoil from the coughing man.
units.italian: "Sì", dice semplicemente. Ti ritrai d'istinto dall'uomo che tossisce.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	"First your eyes itch, then your throat, then your lungs. By then it's too late, too late. But there are always those who never learn."|1022|0
units.english: "First your eyes itch, then your throat, then your lungs. By then it's too late, too late. But there are always those who never learn."
units.italian: "Prima ti prudono gli occhi, poi la gola, poi i polmoni. A quel punto è troppo tardi, troppo tardi. Ma c'è sempre chi non impara."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	He grins with derision. "Well, I'll chop you up and throw you to the Bloom if you don't buy some fish from me. Three barrels." He reaches in and pulls a fish out. "Still fresh. 1000 credits each."|1023|0
units.english: He grins with derision. "Well, I'll chop you up and throw you to the Bloom if you don't buy some fish from me. Three barrels." He reaches in and pulls a fish out. "Still fresh. 1000 credits each."
units.italian: Sorride con derisione. "Beh, ti farò a pezzi e ti getterò alla Fioritura se non mi compri del pesce. Tre barili." Ficca la mano dentro e tira fuori un pesce. "Ancora fresco. 1000 crediti l'uno."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	(Buy three barrels of fish from him.)|1025|0
units.english: (Buy three barrels of fish from him.)
units.italian: (Compra tre barili di pesce da lui.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	(Buy two barrels of fish from him.)|1029|0
units.english: (Buy two barrels of fish from him.)
units.italian: (Compra due barili di pesce da lui.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	(Buy one barrel of fish from him.)|1033|0
units.english: (Buy one barrel of fish from him.)
units.italian: (Compra un barile di pesce da lui.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	(Make a run for it.)|1037|0
units.english: (Make a run for it.)
units.italian: (Scappo via.)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	You whirl around and walk quickly the other way. You can still hear the cursing in your ears when you get to your ship.|1038|0
units.english: You whirl around and walk quickly the other way. You can still hear the cursing in your ears when you get to your ship.
units.italian: Ti giri di colpo e ti allontani in fretta nella direzione opposta. Senti ancora le imprecazioni nelle orecchie quando arrivi alla nave.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	You fish out the money for three barrels and hand it to him. He feels it suspiciously. Once he's satisfied, you roll the barrels back to the spaceport. After an exhausting few hours of one price dispute after another, you manage to sell them at the spaceport trading panel for 2100 credits.|1043|0
units.english: You fish out the money for three barrels and hand it to him. He feels it suspiciously. Once he's satisfied, you roll the barrels back to the spaceport. After an exhausting few hours of one price dispute after another, you manage to sell them at the spaceport trading panel for 2100 credits.
units.italian: Tiri fuori i soldi per tre barili e glieli consegni. Li soppesa con sospetto. Quando è soddisfatto, rotoli i barili fino allo spazioporto. Dopo qualche ora estenuante di una trattativa dopo l'altra, riesci a venderli al pannello commerciale dello spazioporto per 2100 crediti.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	You fish out the money for two barrels and hand it to him. He feels it suspiciously, and grumbles something about the one remaining barrel. You roll the barrels back to the spaceport and, after an hour of hard work, manage to sell them at the spaceport trading panel for 1400 credits.|1048|0
units.english: You fish out the money for two barrels and hand it to him. He feels it suspiciously, and grumbles something about the one remaining barrel. You roll the barrels back to the spaceport and, after an hour of hard work, manage to sell them at the spaceport trading panel for 1400 credits.
units.italian: Tiri fuori i soldi per due barili e glieli consegni. Li soppesa con sospetto e borbotta qualcosa sull'unico barile rimasto. Rotoli i barili fino allo spazioporto e, dopo un'ora di duro lavoro, riesci a venderli al pannello commerciale per 1400 crediti.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Bloodsea|	You fish out the money and hand it to him. He rubs it, then explodes in rage. "Get out!" he shouts, throwing the credit chips at your face. You make a run for it, and by the time you get to your ship, you realize that you left 294 credits with the old man in your hurry to escape.|1053|0
units.english: You fish out the money and hand it to him. He rubs it, then explodes in rage. "Get out!" he shouts, throwing the credit chips at your face. You make a run for it, and by the time you get to your ship, you realize that you left 294 credits with the old man in your hurry to escape.
units.italian: Tiri fuori i soldi e glieli consegni. Li strofina, poi esplode di rabbia. "Fuori!" urla, lanciandoti in faccia i gettoni di credito. Scappi, e quando arrivi alla nave ti rendi conto di aver lasciato 294 crediti con il vecchio nella fretta di fuggire.
